callLabel: Design partner call · sample output
shapeNote: Rapport and discovery were strong, agenda and frame were not. They liked you and they coached you, and you spent the call in their meeting instead of yours.
footerLeft: Scored against anchors, weighted for a partnership call, then capped at the weakest deal-critical dimension plus 3.

dimensions.name: Agenda execution
dimensions.why: Two of four planned segments ran. Pricing was never opened, and the pilot scope doc was mentioned but never put on screen.

dimensions.name: Frame control
dimensions.why: They set the topic order from 06:10 onward. You answered fourteen questions in a row without asking one back.

dimensions.name: Discovery and listening
dimensions.why: You got the renewal date, the name of the internal champion, and the number they have to beat, in their own words.

dimensions.name: Objection handling
dimensions.why: Two objections answered cleanly, but the security review was accepted as a fact with no test of who owns it or how long it normally takes.

dimensions.name: Closing
dimensions.why: The ask came at 51:40 with four minutes left. The next step has an owner but no date, so nothing is actually scheduled.

dimensions.name: Rapport
dimensions.why: They volunteered a peer introduction unprompted and stayed nine minutes past the hour.
